name: base
purpose: vref 0.62 V (soft start clamps at vref without overshoot); soft reference reaches vref while vfb is still far, so power good stays low; duty rises to duty_max and falls to duty_min with full PWM patterns; pgood qualifies, is lost for one edge and requalifies; two-edge enable-low clear and restart of soft start, duty and carrier; one-edge reset clear
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vvfb (vfb 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.11 236.3n 0.11 236.5n 0.6275 268.3n 0.6275 268.5n 0.66 276.3n 0.66 276.5n 0.6275 388.3n 0.6275 388.5n 0.59 421.3n 0.59 421.5n 0.06 600n 0.06]

tran tran stop=600n maxstep=50p strobeperiod=50p
save vfb vref clk rst enable pwm duty_metric soft_ref pgood
